Implemented modal dialogs, drawer navigations, and real-time state feedback, keeping interaction latency below 100ms.

Delivered responsive web portals and client admin dashboards with dynamic tables, booking forms, and export utilities.
Ensured strict design fidelity against Figma specs: typography scales, spacing tokens, color palettes, and interactive states (hover/active/disabled).
Provided clean handover documentation and setup guides for seamless client deployment.
